item.title: PillPad 0.1.2
item.description:
### Fixed
- **A template every time you start a canvas.** The chooser now appears on
  the new canvas itself, so launching the app, pressing ⌘N and clicking the
  dock icon with no windows open all start the same way. On some Macs the
  launch could previously end on the standard Open dialog instead. ⇧⌘N
  still goes straight to a blank canvas.
- **About opens on its own** when no document window is available to show
  it.

item.title: PillPad 0.1.1
item.description:
### Fixed
- **Revert keeps your work.** Reverting to the saved version (or browsing
  earlier versions) now shows the reverted canvas, and edits you make
  afterwards are saved to the file as expected.
- **Group and Ungroup shortcuts work.** ⌘G and ⇧⌘G do what the menu says.
- **Drag a group by its outline.** Grabbing a group's boundary moves the
  whole group, members and all. Drawing a flow from a pill's edge is
  unchanged.
- **The template chooser gets out of the way.** Opening a document from the
  Finder, Open Recent or the Open panel dismisses the chooser.
- **Cleaner undo.** Colour and slider changes in the inspector no longer
  tangle with the step that follows them, and pressing Undo mid-drag lets go
  of the drag cleanly.
- **Big diagrams stay responsive.** Zoom to Fit on a canvas with a far-off
  element no longer hangs, and PNG export of a very spread-out canvas keeps
  the image to a sensible size.

### Added
- **Source view.** Switch any document between Design and Source to edit the
  canvas as live JSON; each burst of typing is one undo step, and a typo
  keeps the last good canvas on screen with a clear message.
- **LLM instructions.** Help ▸ LLM Instructions… (or `PillPad --instructions`)
  gives a chat model the .pillpad format so it can draft diagrams for you;
  `PillPad --open file.pillpad` checks a file and opens it.

item.title: PillPad 0.1.0
item.description:
### Added
- **First release of PillPad.** A native macOS diagramming whiteboard for
  sketching how a business fits together: pills you name after people,
  groups you label as departments, and flows that show who reports to whom.
- **Pills, groups, flows, shapes and text.** Drop a pill and type its name,
  draw a boundary around a cluster and label it, pull a flow from one pill's
  edge to another (or to a whole department) and label the line. Rectangles,
  ellipses, diamonds, lines and free text cover everything that isn't an org
  chart.
- **Everything is undoable.** Moves, resizes, recolours, grouping, deleting —
  ⌘Z steps back through all of it, and your document autosaves as you work.
- **Start from a template.** Choose Blank, Org Structure or Process Flow when
  you create a document; each card shows a live preview of what you'll get.
- **Export for the deck.** Save the canvas as a crisp PNG or a PDF with real
  text, ready to drop into a slide or an email after the meeting.
- **Your files are yours.** A `.pillpad` document is plain JSON you can keep
  in iCloud Drive, Dropbox or a git repo, and open with Open Recent like any
  other Mac document.
- **Auto-updates.** PillPad checks for new versions on its own and installs
  them in one click.
